name: Official filesystem server: pinned package, stock tool descriptions

tool.name: read_file
tool.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read.

tool.name: write_file
tool.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files.

tool.name: list_directory
tool.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path, including sizes and modification dates.
